title: Audit log
description: Every recorded action on the platform, newest first.
readOnly: The audit log is a read-only record. Entries cannot be changed or removed.

table.label: Audit log entries
table.caption: Recorded actions, with the entity each one touched and its outcome.

entry.compareFor: Compare the recorded fields of entry {{id}}

filters.entityTypePlaceholder: Kind of entity the action touched
filters.boundHint: Read as Coordinated Universal Time, the time zone the log is recorded in.

pagination.pageSize: Up to {{size}} audit log entries per page.

comparison.title: Recorded field values
comparison.caption: The value of each field before and after the recorded action.
comparison.noSnapshots: This entry recorded no field values.
comparison.noChanges: No field value changed in this entry.

verify.title: Chain integrity
verify.description: Check that no recorded entry has been altered since it was written.
verify.intact: Every checked entry matches the record written before it.
verify.tampered: Verification failed at audit log entry {{id}}. Treat every entry from that point on as unverified and escalate this immediately.
verify.tamperedUnknown: Verification failed, but the service reported no failing entry identifier. Escalate this immediately.

announce.loaded: The audit log entries have been loaded.
announce.empty: No audit log entries match the current filters.
announce.failed: The audit log entries could not be loaded.
announce.verifyIntact: The audit chain verified as intact.
announce.verifyFailed: The audit chain could not be verified.
